basis: October 30, 2025 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I verified. FET reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $196,231,000 for Q3 2025 against $207,806,000 for Q3 2024, a 5.57% decline. The August 8 forecast reached $200,000,000, above the $197,415,700 cutoff. I recovered a complete 29-slide issuer deck that matches the September archive on slide count and two specific slides. Its revenue outlook was annual. Two gaps prevent a dated verdict: I could not establish that the September copy was identical throughout or verify the complete May 21 management remarks.

coverage.detail: February 20 Q4 2024 release. The $85–105 million 2025 outlook covered full-year adjusted EBITDA. It supplied no Q3 2025 revenue ceiling.

May 1 Q1 release. FET guided Q2 adjusted EBITDA to $18–22 million and annual free cash flow to $40–60 million. On May 2, management said a revenue decline could start in Q3 if oil and gas prices failed to rebound, without quantifying it. [Call transcript](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-forum-energys-q1-2025-highlights-innovation-and-steady-growth-93CH-4020553)

Newly identified event. FET’s May 19 notice scheduled both the CEO and CFO for a May 21, 2025 Water Tower fireside chat. The issuer-linked Zoom page yielded no accessible replay. Stock Analysis indexes the event as “Status Update” and summarizes rig-count risk and an EBITDA scenario. Its full transcript returned a cache miss. [Host event](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/8017473999850/WN_Cl0amNonSxqEckgJj50SrQ) · [Transcript index](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fet/transcripts/) · [Transcript attempt](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fet/transcripts/348995-status-update/)

Recovered FET’s June 11 Sidoti deck. It identifies $193 million as Q1 revenue. In the public transcript, the CEO repeated the conditional Q3 decline scenario without a revenue amount. The issuer-linked Sidoti webcast yielded no accessible replay. [Issuer event notice](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/14531/pdf) · [Host webcast](https://sidoti.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_jEOADeu3TFixeVnzaVzbng) · [Public remarks](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-sidotis-conference-strategic-insights-and-growth-93CH-4091481)
August 7 Q2 release. Q3 adjusted EBITDA guidance was $19–23 million. The $60–80 million range covered annual free cash flow. Neither establishes Q3 sales.

August 8 call. CFO Lyle Williams forecast Q3 revenue of $180–200 million. Its high end exceeded the cutoff by $2,584,300. His separate $760–800 million forecast covered 2025. FET announced a same-day replay, but its reports archive exposes only the release and 10-Q for Q2 2025. The numeric range is verifiable in the public transcript. [Issuer replay notice](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/14586/pdf) · [Issuer reports archive](https://ir.f-e-t.com/financial-information/reports)
August 18 issuer announcement covered the NYSE Texas secondary listing and supplied no quarterly sales update.

September 18 Water Tower chat. The CFO’s approximately 5% decline compared Q3 industry activity with Q1. The $85 million figure covered annual EBITDA. The public transcript gives no tighter Q3 consolidated sales range. Neither the issuer-linked Zoom page nor the host website yielded an accessible official recording or transcript. [Public remarks](https://ng.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-water-tower-chat-strategic-growth-and-cash-flow-focus-93CH-2110286) · [Event webcast](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/2017575113620/WN_sntytto3SO-Kr-CF2ENr4w) · [Water Tower Research](https://www.watertowerresearch.com/)
September 19 Form 8-K reported director Leslie Beyer’s retirement under Item 5.02. It contained no revenue update or investor deck.

Recovered FET’s complete 29-slide presentation titled “Second Quarter 2025.” Slide 3 shows $393 million of first-half consolidated revenue and slide 15 shows $233 million of first-half Drilling and Completions revenue. Both match the indexed September slides. The forecast footnote gives $760–800 million of full-year 2025 revenue. Subtracting first-half sales would cover Q3 and Q4 together. The deck supplies no explicit Q3 revenue ceiling. [Archived slide 3](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?bd=false&doc=110809&f=IsHistorical.1&q=&slide=3007050) · [Archived slide 15](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?bd=false&doc=110809&f=IsHistorical.1&q=&slide=3007062&v=1)

PLS lists the 29-slide September deck as document 110809 under September 29. Its full-document and cover-slide requests were inaccessible. FET’s current presentations page supplies a later deck, and the historical IR snapshot request was inaccessible. September 29 therefore remains an archive date with no independently verified issuer posting date. [Full-document attempt](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?doc=110809) · [Cover attempt](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?doc=110809&slide=3007048) · [Issuer presentations](https://ir.f-e-t.com/events-and-presentations/presentations) · [Historical snapshot attempt](https://web.archive.org/web/20250930/https://ir.f-e-t.com/events-and-presentations/presentations)
October 6 notice scheduled the October 31 call and said results would be released beforehand. It gave no preliminary revenue.

October 30 actuals. The consolidated income statement reports revenue in thousands of dollars for the three months ended September 30: 196,231 in 2025 and 207,806 in 2024. Both values come from the same GAAP revenue row. The headline’s 2% decrease is sequential.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer release carries an October 30, 2025 dateline. Item 2.02 of the October 31 Form 8-K explicitly confirms that FET issued the earnings release on October 30 for the quarter ended September 30. This establishes the public date of the actuals. [Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1401257/000140125725000106/fet-20251030.htm)
